labelInUi: Reference table — no tool is opened live in this scene
premise: The contract lives in the repository. The execution surface is a choice, and it is reversible.
$comment: Four SURFACES, not four vendors. Products are named only as current examples of a surface; the surface is the durable idea and the example list will change.
sharedContract: AGENTS.md — what may change and what must not
app/test/ — the acceptance criteria as executable checks

surfaces.name: IDE
surfaces.contractMechanism: AGENTS.md and the repository files, read from the working tree
surfaces.producesEvidenceIn: The same pull request, checked by the same workflows
surfaces.licensing: Independent of GitHub Copilot licensing where the tool is
surfaces.note: A team that prefers its editor keeps its editor. Nothing in this repository is specific to one of them.

surfaces.name: CLI
surfaces.contractMechanism: AGENTS.md and the repository files; in Actions, a compiled workflow definition
surfaces.producesEvidenceIn: The same pull request, or safe outputs on an issue
surfaces.licensing: Varies by tool; model access can route through the Copilot provider or a separate key
surfaces.note: This is the surface the experimental intake lane uses, and it is shown as prepared output rather than run live.

surfaces.name: Purpose-built agent app
surfaces.note: A dedicated surface rather than an editor plugin. One option among the four, not the point of the session.

surfaces.name: GitHub-hosted cloud agents
surfaces.examples: Copilot cloud agent, plus documented preview partners
surfaces.contractMechanism: The issue, AGENTS.md, and the repository
surfaces.producesEvidenceIn: A pull request it opens itself
surfaces.licensing: Copilot; consumes Actions minutes and AI credits
surfaces.note: Needs no developer machine and starts from an issue. GitHub lists third-party partners in public preview, currently Anthropic Claude and OpenAI Codex, enabled and billed through Copilot policy. Nothing here depends on them.

whatDoesNotChangeBetweenSurfaces: The specification the work starts from
The tests that decide whether it is correct
The checks that must be green
The rules that gate the merge
